shortDescription: Allows administration of Keycloak client authorization permissions using Keycloak API

options.name: auth_client_id
options.description: OpenID Connect C(client_id) to authenticate to the API with.

options.name: auth_client_secret
options.description: Client Secret to use in conjunction with O(auth_client_id) (if required).

options.name: auth_keycloak_url
options.description: URL to the Keycloak instance.

options.name: auth_password
options.description: Password to authenticate for API access with.

options.name: auth_realm
options.description: Keycloak realm name to authenticate to for API access.

options.name: auth_username
options.description: Username to authenticate for API access with.

options.name: client_id
options.description: The clientId of the keycloak client that should have the authorization scope. This is usually a human-readable name of the Keycloak client.

options.name: connection_timeout
options.description: Controls the HTTP connections timeout period (in seconds) to Keycloak API.

options.name: decision_strategy
options.description: The decision strategy to use with this permission.

options.name: description
options.description: The description of the authorization permission.

options.name: http_agent
options.description: Configures the HTTP User-Agent header.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the authorization permission to create.

options.name: permission_type
options.description: The type of authorization permission. On V(scope) create a scope-based permission. On V(resource) create a resource-based permission.

options.name: policies
options.description: Policy names to attach to this permission.

options.name: realm
options.description: The name of the Keycloak realm the Keycloak client is in.

options.name: refresh_token
options.description: Authentication refresh token for Keycloak API.

options.name: resources
options.description: Resource names to attach to this permission. Scope-based permissions can only include one resource. Resource-based permissions can include multiple resources.

options.name: scopes
options.description: Scope names to attach to this permission. Resource-based permissions cannot have scopes attached to them.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the authorization permission. On V(present), the authorization permission is created (or updated if it exists already). On V(absent), the authorization permission is removed if it exists.

options.name: token
options.description: Authentication token for Keycloak API.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Verify TLS certificates (do not disable this in production).
